items.exampleEn: The bathroom floor is covered with white tiles.

items.exampleEn: Write your answers in blue or black ink.
items.exampleZh: 請用藍色或黑色墨水寫答案。

items.exampleEn: This plug doesn't fit the hole in the wall.
items.exampleZh: 這個插頭插不進牆上的插座。

items.exampleEn: The baby is having her nap, so please be quiet.

items.exampleEn: This old lighter doesn't work anymore.
items.exampleZh: 這個舊打火機已經不能用了。

items.exampleEn: Our office heater broke, so we wore coats all day.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室的暖氣機壞了，所以我們整天都穿著外套。

items.sentenceEn: Don't leave the heater on when you go out.
items.sentenceZh: 出門時不要讓暖氣開著。

items.audioEn: We need new tiles for the kitchen floor, but they are expensive.
items.audioZh: 我們廚房地板需要新的瓷磚，但很貴。
options: A new table for the kitchen.

Tiles for the floor of the kitchen.

items.sentenceEn: The printer is out of ink again.
My grandmother's old pottery is worth a lot of money.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶的老陶器很值錢。

items.stemEn: After a long night, he took a quick ____ on the sofa.
items.stemZh: 熬了一整夜後，他在沙發上小睡了一下。

items.stemEn: Turn on the ____; the room is freezing.

items.passageEn: My grandmother's house is relatively small, but it is very comfortable. The kitchen has blue tiles that she chose fifty years ago. In the living room, there are soft cushions everywhere and a small electric heater for winter. She makes pottery as a hobby, and her cups are on every shelf. After lunch, she always takes a nap in her favorite chair. She doesn't smoke, but she keeps a lighter in a drawer for birthday candles.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶的房子相對小，但非常舒適。廚房鋪著她五十年前挑的藍色瓷磚。客廳裡到處都是軟軟的靠墊，還有一台冬天用的小電暖器。她把做陶藝當興趣，每個架子上都擺著她做的杯子。午餐後，她總會坐在最喜歡的椅子上睡個午覺。她不抽菸，但抽屜裡放著一個打火機，用來點生日蠟燭。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶廚房的瓷磚是什麼顏色？
奶奶為什麼在抽屜裡放打火機？

items.promptZh: 睡前請把電暖器的插頭拔掉。
referenceEn: Please pull out the heater's plug before bed.
Before you go to bed, please pull the plug out of the heater.
rubricZh: 「拔掉插頭」可寫 pull out the plug、unplug 等
祈使句用原形動詞開頭（Please 可加在句首）

items.promptZh: 我爸爸每天吃完午飯後都會睡個午覺。
referenceEn: My father takes a nap after lunch every day.
Every day, my dad has a nap after lunch.
rubricZh: 用 nap 表示「午睡」（例如 takes a nap、has a nap 等）
